mia: Quick smoke check — after landing the prefix-slot packing change I see a drop in overall prefix cache hit rate on one fleet (r6). p50/p95 latency looks stable but evictions spiked. Anyone else hit this? cc @raj

raj: I noticed an alert earlier but assumed transient. Can you paste the exact command you used for the smoke run?

mia: Ran this locally: `./perf/run_kv_smoke --prefix-window=512 --clients=8 --steps=1000 --dataset=canary`
Results excerpt:
```
hit_rate: 0.82  # baseline ~0.94
evictions: 312  # ~100 baseline
prefetch_hit: 0.12
sample_fragmentation_score: 0.37
```
Logs show a lot of short-lived fragments and many small insert/delete churn on adjacent slots.

sam: can you ask the perf-bot for the canonical summary? @perf-bot

perf-bot: (automated) benchmark summary for thread 1872509999: job=kv-smoke-512, cluster=canary-r6, hit_rate=0.82, evictions=312, prefetch_hit=0.12, frag_score=0.37

jia: possible cause: the new slot packing tries to squeeze prefixes tighter which can increase fragmentation for interleaved write patterns. Did you try toggling the align_prefix_windows flag?

mia: not yet. Re-running with align disabled: `./perf/run_kv_smoke --prefix-window=512 --clients=8 --steps=1000 --align-prefix-windows=false` — kicking off now.

raj: also check compaction and metadata sweep cadence. If compaction became more aggressive it might temporarily increase short fragments until background consolidation catches up.

mia: rerun finished: hit_rate -> 0.91, evictions down to ~120. Seems flipping align-prefix-windows fixes the regression in this workload.

sam: nice. Can you add the reproduce command and both outputs to the PR so reviewers can validate? Also add a small perf test that covers interleaved writes + small prefixes.

mia: will do. Plan: small PR that (1) reverts default for the packing flag, (2) adds a canary perf test, (3) docs note about fragmentation tradeoff. Ping @jia for rollout gating.

jia: please add a short note in rollout checklist to monitor per-node evictions and sample_fragmentation_score for first 24h. If looks stable after canary, we can flip the flag cluster-by-cluster.

perf-bot: (automated) new job queued: kv-smoke-512-align-off for canary validation

raj: thanks — once PR is up ping #eng-releases and put the canary nodes in the release notes so SRE can watch the eviction graphs.

mia: PR incoming in ~30m. adding tests + benchmark artifacts. :thumbsup:

sam: I'll review the test and the perf harness. If it's small we can land and start canary immediately.

mia: updated — pushed branch `mia/kv-align-default-off` with run logs and perf-agent link. pinging reviewers.
